title: Stagger & Horns Playbook
intro: Redrawn from the notebook pages. Tap Play on any play to watch it run, and use the steps under each diagram to go through it one at a time.

plays.title: Reverse
plays.sub: Reverse the ball, 2 comes off the stagger for a catch-and-shoot.

frames.cap: 1 reverses the ball through 5 to 4.
1 and 5 stagger. 2 curls off both screens to the top.

plays.title: Curl the stagger
plays.sub: 2 uses the double screen and curls. 5 chooses which direction to go.

frames.cap: Reverse the ball through the 5
Stagger away, 2 then curls action and goes to the rim
5 pops receives a pass from 4
3 and 4 stagger pin down for 2 to come off and shoot

plays.title: UCLA
plays.sub: 2 uses the double screen, revieves the pass, swings it back to the 4 and front cuts after a screen from the 5. Then if no option is taken off that cut, we go back into a stagger pin down for the 2 to shoot.

frames.cap: Reverse the ball through the 5
Stagger away, 2 then curls action and goes to the rim
5 pops receives a pass from 4
5 pops receives a pass from 4
5 pops receives a pass from 4
3 and 4 stagger pin down for 2 to come off and shoot

plays.title: One
plays.sub: Reverse trigger, stagger away but PG fakes the first screen and comes back to receive the ball.

frames.cap: 1 reverses the ball through 5 to 4.
1 and 5 stagger. 1 fakes and curls off screen from 5 to the top.
This becomes a horns style action
4 fake screens and ghosts through the action to the opposite side
Then it can flow into a PnR if no other options are available.

plays.title: Rubio
reads: 5 screens for 1 as 2 runs through on the Spain action.

frames.cap: 1 keeps the ball
4 and 5 stagger away (no reversal)
3 comes off recieves the ball. 5 man turns to set a PnR. 2 man cuts through to meet for screen or cut through( we are now in our Spain action)
3 man comes off 5 screen. 2 pops andf 5 man rolls
3 man decides on the best option
